description: This Java class 'ReadableOrderTotalPopulator' functions as a data converter that populates ReadableOrderTotal objects from OrderTotal instances, utilizing services for pricing and localization.

classes.name: ReadableOrderTotalPopulator
classes.description: A populator class that converts OrderTotal entities into ReadableOrderTotal representations, facilitating data presentation with localization and pricing formatting.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts an OrderTotal object into a ReadableOrderTotal, applying localization and pricing display formatting.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ReadableOrderTotal.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the current PricingService used by this populator.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Sets the PricingService to be used for price display formatting.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns the LabelUtils instance used for message localization.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets the LabelUtils instance used for message localization.
